standard_prerequisites.name: The local description of a finitely presented module as a quotient of a finite direct sum of the structure sheaf by a submodule of finite type

standard_prerequisites.name: The finiteness of the extension in a short exact sequence whose outer terms are of finite type, and the finiteness of images of finite type modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author lemma lemma-extension-finite-type, whose statement is reproduced verbatim as a context span of this card (source lines 1071-1081)
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the submodule generated by the image of the given map is again of finite type.

core_obligations: Write the module as a quotient: locally the finitely presented module is the quotient of a finite direct sum of the structure sheaf by a submodule of finite type (proof lines 1658-1661)

Locate the image: the image of the given map is the quotient of a submodule of that finite direct sum containing the previous one, and it is of finite type because it is a quotient of the finite type source (proof lines 1661-1667)

Apply the extension statement: by the context lemma the larger submodule is of finite type, so the cokernel of the given map, being the quotient of the finite direct sum by that submodule, is finitely presented (proof lines 1667-1670)
proof_roadmap: 局部写 F = O_X^{⊕n}/M，其中 M 是有限型子模；于是 Im(φ) = N/M，N 是包含 M 的子模。
Im(φ) 因 G 有限型而有限型；由 lemma-extension-finite-type（本卡 context span）得 N 有限型，故 Coker(φ) = O_X^{⊕n}/N 有限表现。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the cokernel of a map from a module of finite type into a finitely presented module is again finitely presented (author lemma at source lines 1648-1655, label lemma-cokernel-finite-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 1657-1671) writes the module locally as a quotient of a finite direct sum by a finite type submodule, identifies the image of the given map with the quotient of a larger submodule, uses that this image is of finite type and the context lemma to conclude that the larger submodule is of finite type, and reads off finite presentation of the cokernel (proof lines 1658-1670). The reduction to a statement about submodules of a finite free module is the content. H2.
